provenance.canonicalisation: RFC 8785 JCS via scripts/jcs.py; set hash is SHA-256 over JCS(vectors).
provenance.signatures: Ed25519 over domain || lowercase SHA-256 hex using fixed public test seeds; dependency-free RFC 8032 verifier.
provenance.status: candidate — no Demos runtime guarantee and no second-implementation cross-run yet
provenance.syntheticProofProfile: demos-bft-proof/test-1 fixtures define outputHash as SHA-256(JCS(storageOutput)), SHA-256(JCS(native transfer payload)), or SHA-256(JCS({accepted:true,operationId})); effectsRoot is SHA-256(JCS({pre,post})). These are test-only formulas, not production Demos wire claims.

coverage.note: ruleRefs provide rule-ID coverage; absence from a polarity set is an explicit conformance gap, not implicit coverage.

vectors.name: aw-auth-complete-envelope
vectors.reason: Each required role signs the full operation envelope for the recomputed Work.

vectors.name: aw-auth-mutation-invalidates
vectors.reason: Mutating a signed envelope member invalidates both binding and signature.

vectors.name: aw-auth-operation-index-binding
vectors.reason: ID, index and kind must identify the same signed operation.

vectors.name: aw-auth-work-replay
vectors.reason: Authorization cannot be replayed to another Work.

vectors.name: aw-auth-required-role-missing
vectors.reason: Every operation role needs its own authorization.

vectors.name: aw-outer-submitter-is-not-role
vectors.reason: An unrelated outer sender does not alter signed DACS role authorization.

vectors.name: aw-payer-signer-mismatch
vectors.reason: Vet/orchestrator authority does not become payer authority.

vectors.name: aw-payer-role-relabel
vectors.reason: A signature for one role cannot be relabelled as payer.

vectors.name: aw-auth-version-algorithm-bound
vectors.reason: Algorithm and version are signed envelope members.

vectors.name: aw-auth-signature-bytes-invalid
vectors.reason: A syntactically shaped but false signature is rejected cryptographically.

vectors.name: aw-auth-signature-base64url-alias
vectors.reason: A non-canonical Base64URL alias of valid signature bytes is rejected.

vectors.name: aw-auth-signature-wrong-length
vectors.reason: An Ed25519 authorization signature must decode to exactly 64 bytes.

vectors.name: aw-auth-public-key-wrong-length
vectors.reason: An Ed25519 public key must decode to exactly 32 bytes.

vectors.name: aw-auth-capability-network-substitution
vectors.reason: An authenticated capability for another network cannot authorize this Work.

vectors.name: aw-auth-capability-execution-substitution
vectors.reason: An authenticated capability for another execution profile cannot authorize this Work.

vectors.name: aw-auth-capability-profile-substitution
vectors.reason: The capability must admit the exact signed Work profile.

vectors.name: aw-auth-capability-schema-substitution
vectors.reason: Authorization consumes the exact authenticated operation-kind and payload-schema map.

vectors.name: aw-auth-capability-operation-kind-duplicate
vectors.reason: Set-equivalent operation-kind lists with duplicates are not the exact canonical capability list.

vectors.name: aw-auth-capability-proof-profile-substitution
vectors.reason: Authorization cannot adopt a proof profile merely because an attacker re-signed a capability.

vectors.name: aw-auth-forged-self-consistent-roster
vectors.reason: A self-consistent roster and signature set cannot override authenticated agreement, bundle, and payer authority maps.

vectors.name: aw-auth-role-authority-missing
vectors.reason: Missing independent agreement/bundle/payer authority cannot establish a roster role.
